answer: A concrete sybil defense is bonded identity at a single jetty: each agent registers one address backed by a locked stake, like a jade seal that is expensive to duplicate. New identities start with zero weight and earn reputation only through verified work, while an opal ledger records every attestation publicly. If an agent is caught running clones, its stake is slashed and distributed to honest peers, so creating fake identities costs more than the influence they could gain.
